content:
**The Slasher: Blood Will Have Blood** is a main quest in *Fallout 76*. It will be implemented in the upcoming fall 2026 update. It is the fourth and final quest associated with The Slasher, a cycle of limited-time seasonal content.

This quest is only available for a limited-time, when The Slasher seasonal content is active. It is associated with the final phase, the "finale," of the seasonal content, as tracked by The Slasher overarching side quest.

Blood Will Have Blood is started automatically once it is enabled as part of The Slasher's finale period, unless the previous quests (Masked Truth, Secrets to the Grave, and Out of the Shadows) have not yet been completed. The previous three quests must be completed in order to advance to Blood Will Have Blood, regardless of The Slasher's phase-based progression. The first objective of the quest is to listen to a radio broadcast, known as "a warning," narrated by the Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher impersonating Remington Goodwin and addressing bounties being placed on him. The holotape broadcast recording: a warning is added to the player character's inventory once the message ends and the broadcast is lost.

The quest then prompts the player to complete Head Hunts for a chance to find the Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher. It may take several Head Hunts to find the Slasher, who is not guaranteed to appear and will only spawn *after* the initial Head Hunt target is defeated, in a manner similar to uninvited guests in public events. When the Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher spawns, a notification appears in the top left corner of the screen, and a visual filter is applied to make the screen black-and-white with occasional static. The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher is an extremely powerful power armor-clad four-star legendary enemy. Once he is defeated, the quest concludes.

The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher can continue to be fought in subsequent Head Hunts even after the completion of this quest, in which he will respawn as a new uninvited guest, while The Slasher content is active. However, the visual filter is only active during Blood Will Have Blood and will not appear on subsequent fights.
